incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered - PD:INC12345 - service: inference-api - symptom: p99 latency > 2.5s on route `/v1/generate` in eu-west-1 for the last 2m. p95 1.2s -> p99 3.8s. Link: <https://pagerduty/INC12345>

alex: I'm on call, paging now. ACKed in PD.

sam: saw same - looks like batching queue depth spiked, ~80% of requests queued. Adding alert query for context...

sam: ```
sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate",region="eu-west-1"}[2m])) by (le)
```

mira: I'm jumping in to help stabilize. Any recent deploys?

alex: No deploys in last hour. Autoscaler shows no new GPUs spun up yet. Possible coldstart or hotkey.

jordan: Noticed hotkey for prompt id 93 — ~40% of traffic hitting same prefix. Could be a runaway client. Can we throttle that key?

alex: Initiating temporary route rule to limit concurrency for key: client-93. Pushing rule to edge now.

ops-bot: rule apply request submitted: rule-id=rl-7654. Status: queued -> applied :white_check_mark:

sam: Also bumping capacity: scaled dedicated pool eu-west-1 from 8 -> 12 GPUs, request sent to autoscaler.

ops-bot: autoscaler API accepted scale request id=scale-8821, target=12, ETA ~90s

mira: Good. Also enabling KV cache warmup for recent prefixes to reduce model decode latency. Command: `warmup --route /v1/generate --prefix-size 128`

leo: Warmup kickstarted. Starting gradual rollback for the latest model variant on eu-west-1 to previous stable v2.3.

alex: PD ack to owner, tracking on the thread. @mira you take lead after the scale shows green.

mira: Ack. I'll monitor. Current p99 trending down from 3.8s -> 2.2s.

jordan: After rate-limit on client-93 traffic dropped ~45%. Good signal.

sam: Autoscaler reports nodes ready. p99 now 1.1s, p95 0.9s. Looks within SLO.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC12345: resolved by user 'alex' - status: acknowledged -> resolved. Duration 5m 23s.

alex: Marking mitigated. Leaving follow-up tasks: investigate client-93 spike, add adaptive per-key throttling, replay KV cache strategy. I'll create a ticket.

mira: I'll do a short RCA draft in the ticket. We should consider autoscaler warm reserve for EU peak hours.

leo: Note: rollback didn't change traffic pattern much, main effect from key throttle + scale.

jordan: adding logs: request IDs and sample payloads attached in ticket.

sam: post-incident check: schedule 1h follow-up to validate no regressions.

alex: thanks all. :thumbsup:

mira: handing off to next on-call @jordan for watch window. checkin at +30m.

jordan: taking over, noted. :white_check_mark:

alex: closing thread, file created: LINK_TICKET-4521
